facts.business: Neopolitan Pizza and Foods Limited operates in the quick service restaurant and food business with a focus on vegetarian offerings through company-operated and franchise formats, and also trades in agricultural commodities.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: As at reporting date (31 March 2026): 7 outlets operational, 4 under construction, remaining proposed 16 outlets yet to be established

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Statutory Auditors reported a deviation in utilisation of IPO proceeds, principally relating to utilisation of ₹408.50 lakhs towards working capital requirements in excess of the amount originally specified for that object.

key_risks: Volatility in food and packaging input costs
Intense competition and changing consumer preferences
Dependence on franchise execution and quality consistency
Food safety, licensing and other regulatory risks
Employee retention, real-estate costs and supply-chain disruptions
Cybersecurity and data privacy risks associated with digital channels
